settings.text: Innovation at the service of your shopping
We’ve partnered with Triple-A to offer cryptocurrency payments, a secure and regulated payment solution, for a seamless checkout experience.
After adding your items to the cart, proceed to checkout and select “Triple-A - Crypto Payments”. You will be redirected to our partner’s secure payment interface.

Choose your preferred cryptocurrency and scan the generated QR code using your wallet.
The QR code is valid for 25 minutes, with a guaranteed exchange rate.

Confirm the transaction directly from your cryptocurrency wallet.
Your order is completed once the transaction is validated on the blockchain.

To ensure full price stability during your purchase, the exchange rate is locked and guaranteed for 25 minutes by our partner Triple-A, eliminating any risk of volatility while you complete your order.

We currently accept the following leading cryptocurrencies and crypto payment solutions:

Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Tether (USDT), USD Coin (USDC), PayPal USD (PYUSD), EURC, as well as payments via Binance Pay.

The conversion rate is calculated based on the total amount of your cart in euros. If your cart is displayed in another currency, an automatic conversion will be applied and the final payable amount will be clearly displayed on our partner’s payment page.
